title: Valve are pausing Steam Machine 2TB orders over "supply constraints," though the 512GB model is free of its waitlist
summary: Valve giveth, and Valve taketh away in their latest Steam Machine availability update . The dinky SteamOS PC continues to have a terrible time with AI industry-inflicted hardware parts shortages , which at least for its flagship 2TB model, have become such a problem that Valve are suspending new orders until further notice. While Valve's post says that they "have wrapped up sending purchase invites out to all remaining 2TB reservation holders" – meaning if you'd previously reserved one, you'll still get your chance to buy – "supply restraints" have put the kibosh on any new orders for now.
